description: Portfolio In Pixels 2026: Welcome to Portfolio in Pixels 2026 , an AI Image Generation Competition by itsfolio.tech ! This is a creative challenge where you use Generative AI to turn your experience with itsfolio into an engaging social media creative . Show us how itsfolio helped you build, present, or improve your professional identity through an original AI-generated image. Community: Join the Whatsapp Community for regular updates. The Challenge: Create an AI-generated social media post that tells your personal story with itsfolio. Your creative can showcase how itsfolio helped you transform your resume into a professional portfolio, how your portfolio represents your skills and achievements, your experience using the platform, or how having an online portfolio can help in your career. The Twist: Your own itsfolio portfolio must be visibly incorporated into your AI-generated creative. Think of it as: This is my experience with itsfolio - and this is my portfolio. Your final submission should be creative, original, visually appealing, and social-media ready. Selected entries may also be featured on itsfolio.tech's social media platforms. What Do You Need To Submit? AI-Generated Image - Your final social media creative. AI Prompt - The exact prompt used to generate your image. itsfolio Portfolio Link - Your live portfolio created using itsfolio. Who Can Participate? The competition is open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines, including engineering, management, arts, commerce, science, law, medical, and other fields. Whether you are interested in AI, design, technology, creativity, personal branding, social media, or career development, this challenge is for you. Participation is individual. How Will Entries Be Judged? Creativity & Originality. Quality of AI Generation. Concept & Storytelling. Integration of the Participant's itsfolio Portfolio. Relevance to the Challenge. Overall Visual Impact. Rewards & Prizes: 1st Place - ₹15,000. 2nd

raw.details:
Portfolio In Pixels 2026:

Welcome to Portfolio in Pixels 2026, an AI Image Generation Competition by itsfolio.tech!

This is a creative challenge where you use Generative AI to turn your experience with itsfolio into an engaging social media creative. Show us how itsfolio helped you build, present, or improve your professional identity through an original AI-generated image.

Community:

  • Join the Whatsapp Community for regular updates.

The Challenge:

  • Create an AI-generated social media post that tells your personal story with itsfolio.
  • Your creative can showcase how itsfolio helped you transform your resume into a professional portfolio, how your portfolio represents your skills and achievements, your experience using the platform, or how having an online portfolio can help in your career.

The Twist:

  • Your own itsfolio portfolio must be visibly incorporated into your AI-generated creative.
  • Think of it as:
    • This is my experience with itsfolio - and this is my portfolio.
  • Your final submission should be creative, original, visually appealing, and social-media ready.
  • Selected entries may also be featured on itsfolio.tech's social media platforms.

What Do You Need To Submit?

  • AI-Generated Image - Your final social media creative.
  • AI Prompt - The exact prompt used to generate your image.
  • itsfolio Portfolio Link - Your live portfolio created using itsfolio.

Who Can Participate?

  • The competition is open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines, including engineering, management, arts, commerce, science, law, medical, and other fields.
  • Whether you are interested in AI, design, technology, creativity, personal branding, social media, or career development, this challenge is for you.
  • Participation is individual.

How Will Entries Be Judged?

  • Creativity & Originality.
  • Quality of AI Generation.
  • Concept & Storytelling.
  • Integration of the Participant's itsfolio Portfolio.
  • Relevance to the Challenge.
  • Overall Visual Impact.

Rewards & Prizes:

  • 1st Place - ₹15,000.
  • 2nd Place - ₹10,000.
  • 3rd Place - ₹5,000.
  • Total Prize Pool: ₹30,000.

Create. Generate. Showcase.

Create your professional portfolio on itsfolio.tech, bring your experience to life with Generative AI, and show us your creativity through Portfolio in Pixels 2026.

Your experience. Your creativity. Your portfolio.
